cards.subject: The Barov family crypts
lines: The Cult of the Damned did not build a school. They took a family's donated keep and converted the ancient burial vaults underneath it into classrooms.
Every lecture hall in the lower school is a crypt somebody was already lying in.

cards.subject: The key is built, not found
lines: Bone fragments off the skeletons of Andorhal. A mold bought from a goblin blacksmith in Gadgetzan. A stem forged in the lava of Un'Goro.
A scarab taken off a lich's head.
All of that, for one door.

cards.subject: And then there is a second key
lines: The Skeleton Key only opens the front gate. The Viewing Room is behind another one.
It drops off a bone golem standing in the Great Ossuary.
No golem, no classroom.

cards.subject: A lesson in progress, and nobody attacks you
lines: Two tutors and a row of students, all neutral. You can stand at the back and listen.
They shush you: "Be quiet! Can't you see the master is speaking?"
"Did you forget your student's attire? Do you think fashion is more vital than the Scourge's domination?"

cards.subject: What is actually being taught
lines: The subject is raising plagued dragons from eggs smuggled out of Blackrock Spire.
"Be silent! Do you think our plagued dragons will hatch and train themselves?"
The practical note to the class: torture the prisoner in view of the dragon before you feed it.

cards.subject: The Argent Dawn's answer to a classroom
lines: A quest item you set down inside that room.
It turns every neutral student in the lecture into a hostile skeleton at once.
The Dawn's solution to a room full of enrolled necromancers was a gas.

cards.subject: A war criminal, marking papers
lines: The tutor beside Vectus is Marduk the Black — the death knight who corrupted Joseph Redpath's spirit and let the Scourge take Darrowshire.
A dwarf captain shattered his enchanted sword near Corin's Crossing afterwards.
He ended up here, teaching.

cards.subject: Nobody spawns him by walking in
lines: You carry the Blood of Innocents to a brazier in the Chamber of Summoning and light it. A vampiric gargoyle flies in through the window and lands.
"The blood is still fresh."
He is entirely optional. A group can clear the school and never light it.

cards.subject: The window he came in by stays open
lines: He knocks players backward.
Go through it and you do not die — you land outside the instance, and you run the whole way back in.

cards.subject: Fifteen of her
lines: An archmage and illusionist out of Dalaran, before the family turned. In the Hall of Illusions she splits into copies that are near-indistinguishable.
The real one is told apart only by her gear.
Hit a wrong one and it detonates.

cards.subject: The ghost couple in the halls
lines: The Barovs' household servants, tortured to death by the Butcher to help him refine the plague.
Eva: "The Butcher exposed us to pain that we did not know existed."
Three quests avenge them, and finishing them is what pays for the trinket that makes Caer Darrow visible.

cards.subject: The lich with no phylactery
lines: A hedge mage from Stromgarde who killed himself in Stratholme to be raised. Unlike other liches he never made one, so his soul is still snagged where he died.
You bind it into a keepsake from his human life and use that on him. It makes him mortal.
One of very few times undeath is actually undone.

cards.subject: The Headmaster's Study is empty
lines: He does not exist until six specific bosses elsewhere in the building are dead.
His move is teleporting one player alone into a side room to fight their way back out while the rest keep going without them.
"School is in session!" ... "Class... dismissed."
